scripts.db:migrate:local: printf 'y\n' | npx wrangler d1 migrations apply verba-evals --local
scripts.db:migrate:remote: printf 'y\n' | npx wrangler d1 migrations apply verba-evals --remote
scripts.preview:pages: npm run build && npm run db:migrate:local && npx wrangler pages dev dist
scripts.deploy:pages: npm run build && npm run db:migrate:remote && npx wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name joaquinh-com --branch main --commit-dirty true
scripts.asr:local: uv run --with faster-whisper --with fastapi --with uvicorn --with python-multipart python scripts/local_asr_server.py
